Name: Shamer, Son of Asher
Summary: Father of Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram in Asher's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:34: Father of Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram in Asher's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shamer in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
